payout_quote: Harris County (2025–2026 Elections Manual): presiding judges and deputy early-voting clerks $20/hour; alternate judges, clerks, student clerks, and support specialists $17/hour. Election Day judge stipends in non-primary elections: $120 presiding, $100 alternate.
steps: Work early voting and/or Election Day shifts
Paid hourly ($17–$20) or Election Day stipend ($100–$120 for judges, non-primary)
catches: Hourly rates and stipends can differ in primary and runoff elections — confirm the election-specific schedule.
Election Day judge stipends ($100–$120) may pay less than the hourly rate for a full day.
Positions and hours vary by election.
biggest_catch: Stipend roles can pay less than hourly for the same long day — hourly clerk/judge roles are the better deal.
eligibility: US citizens 18+ registered to vote in Harris County (students 16+ as student clerks).
timing: Paid per county payroll after the election.
